targets.target: the white boxy 1980s sedan (a small model car on the sunlit windowsill at first, the full-size car in the tunnel later)
targets.who: a glossy candy-red modern compact sports hatchback with a thin full-width red LED tail-light bar, a black roof spoiler and dark five-spoke wheels

constraints: Follow the source frame by frame: the red model car sits on the sunlit windowsill for exactly as long as the white model does, the window goes dark at the same moment, and the full-size red car appears in the tunnel only at the moment the full-size white car appears. Do not jump ahead to the tunnel.

The camera keeps pace with the red car exactly as with the white car: in every frame the red car has the same size and position in frame as the white car, seen from behind at the same rear three-quarter left angle. It never pulls away from the camera and never shrinks into the distance.
In the tunnel the warm tunnel lights reflect on the red paint the same way they reflect on the white car, so the red body stays clearly visible.
The windowsill, the forest outside, the train window, the tunnel lights and the road look exactly the same as in the source.
No text, badges, emblems, logos or license plates.
